ResearchProjectDef.label: sling
ResearchProjectDef.description: A braided wool sling and a pouch of river stones. A good slinger can break a helmet at a hundred paces.

ResearchProjectDef.label: unku tunic
ResearchProjectDef.description: Weave the knee-length tunic of alpaca wool, its squares of tocapu patterns telling who the wearer is.

ResearchProjectDef.label: terraces
ResearchProjectDef.description: Cut the hillside into steps, wall each one with stone and fill it with carried soil. A slope becomes a field.

ResearchProjectDef.label: chaski runners
ResearchProjectDef.description:
Relay runners posted along every road, a conch to announce themselves and a quipu to carry. A message crosses the empire in days.
Tradition: Colonists move 3% faster.
Requires 15 Inti knowledge unless this is your heritage.

ResearchProjectDef.label: pachamanca
ResearchProjectDef.description: Heat stones in a pit, lay meat, potatoes and maize on them, cover everything with herbs and earth and wait.

ResearchProjectDef.label: ayni
ResearchProjectDef.description:
Today I help you dig your field, tomorrow you help me roof my house. Work is lent and always repaid.
Tradition: Colonists work 3% faster.
Requires 15 Inti knowledge unless this is your heritage.

ResearchProjectDef.label: mita labour
ResearchProjectDef.description:
Every household sends workers to the state for part of the year: roads, bridges, temples and storehouses rise as if by themselves.
Tradition: Colonists build 5% faster and mine 5% faster.
Requires 20 Inti knowledge unless this is your heritage.

ResearchProjectDef.label: qullqa storehouses
ResearchProjectDef.description:
Round stone storehouses on windy slopes, vented at the floor and roofed with thatch. Grain and dried food keep in them for years.
Requires 10 Inti knowledge unless this is your heritage.

ResearchProjectDef.label: children of the heights
ResearchProjectDef.description:
Broad chests, coca tea, wool and the habit of cold mornings. Inti people work where lowlanders shiver.
Tradition: Colonists are comfortable in 6°C more cold.
Requires 20 Inti knowledge unless this is your heritage.

ResearchProjectDef.label: star mace
ResearchProjectDef.description:
Cast a bronze head with six points and set it on a hardwood staff: the champi of the imperial army.
Requires 10 Inti knowledge unless this is your heritage.

ResearchProjectDef.label: quipu
ResearchProjectDef.description:
Cords of coloured wool knotted in tens, hundreds and thousands, hung from a main cord. Census, tribute and history in one bundle.
Requires 15 Inti knowledge unless this is your heritage.

ResearchProjectDef.label: mountain farming
ResearchProjectDef.description:
A hundred kinds of potato, each for its own height and season, and fields rotated so the soil never tires.
Tradition: Colonists harvest 5% more and sow and harvest 3% faster.
Requires 25 Inti knowledge unless this is your heritage.

ResearchProjectDef.label: royal guard
ResearchProjectDef.description:
The quilted war tunic and the plumed helmet of the guard who carry the emperor's litter.
Requires 25 Inti knowledge unless this is your heritage.

ResearchProjectDef.label: keepers of the knots
ResearchProjectDef.description:
The khipukamayuq, trained from childhood to tie and read the cords. Nothing counted in the empire is ever forgotten.
Tradition: Colonists research 6% faster.
Requires 25 Inti knowledge unless this is your heritage.

ResearchProjectDef.label: kallawaya healers
ResearchProjectDef.description:
Wandering herbalists who know a thousand plants of the mountains and the forest below them.
Tradition: Colonists tend wounds and illness 5% better.
Requires 25 Inti knowledge unless this is your heritage.

ResearchProjectDef.label: slingers of the heights
ResearchProjectDef.description:
Boys and girls of the mountains learn to sling before they learn to herd. In battle the stones come down like hail.
Tradition: Colonists shoot 1 point more accurately and aim 4% faster.
Requires 35 Inti knowledge unless this is your heritage.

ResearchProjectDef.label: mountain carbine
ResearchProjectDef.description:
A short, light carbine for steep ground, with a leather sling and a condor stamped on the lock.
Requires 35 Inti knowledge unless this is your heritage.

ResearchProjectDef.label: great road
ResearchProjectDef.description:
Paved roads along the ridges, rope bridges over the gorges and a resting house every day's walk. Caravans move as fast as runners.
Tradition: Caravans travel 8% faster and colonists build 3% faster.
Requires 45 Inti knowledge unless this is your heritage.

ResearchProjectDef.label: the counted empire
ResearchProjectDef.description:
With Hatun Qulla counted again, the empire knows itself to the last llama and plans as if it could see the future.
Tradition: Colonists research 4% faster, learn 5% faster and work 2% faster.
Requires 50 Inti knowledge unless this is your heritage.
Unlocked by finishing the nation's story.

ResearchProjectDef.label: sling stand
ResearchProjectDef.description:
The slingers of the empire teach the mountain forts to whirl stones without a hand on the cord.
Requires 40 Inti knowledge unless this is your heritage.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Inti powder arms
ResearchProjectDef.description:
The Inti way of making a matchlock or a flintlock: the barrel, the lock, the stock and the drill to use them.
Outside your heritage, this can be researched only once Inti has reached the Age of Powder.
Requires 30 Inti knowledge unless this is your heritage.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Inti steam army
ResearchProjectDef.description:
Cartridges, rifled barrels and a uniform: the army Inti raised when the factories came.
Outside your heritage, this can be researched only once Inti has reached the Age of Steam.
Requires 45 Inti knowledge unless this is your heritage.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Inti electric army
ResearchProjectDef.description:
Machine-made arms, a steel helmet and a field uniform in drab: the army Inti raised when the wires came.
Outside your heritage, this can be researched only once Inti has reached the Electric Age.
Requires 60 Inti knowledge unless this is your heritage.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Inti works
ResearchProjectDef.description:
The first electric works of Inti: one machine the nation is proud of, built to its own taste.
Outside your heritage, this can be researched only once Inti has reached the Electric Age.
Requires 50 Inti knowledge unless this is your heritage.
